tagline: Block-by-block heat and air quality, calibrated and open.
locate-denied: Location not shared — search for your block by name instead.
locate-unavailable: This device can't share a location — search by block name instead.
map-hint: A schematic map of sensor blocks. Each marker states its reading in text; the same data is in the List and Table tabs for any reader the map does not serve.
headline-none: No confirmed air-quality readings for this hour yet — only provisional ones.
headline-worst: Worst confirmed air right now: {place} — AQI {aqi}, {category}.
guide-good: Air quality is good. It's a fine time to be active outside.
guide-moderate: Air quality is acceptable. Unusually sensitive people may want to take it easier on long or intense outdoor activity.
guide-usg: Sensitive groups — people with heart or lung disease, older adults, children, and teens — may feel effects and could shorten long or intense time outdoors. Others are less likely to be affected.
guide-unhealthy: Some people may feel effects; sensitive groups may feel more serious ones. Consider shorter or less intense time outdoors.
guide-vu: Health alert: everyone may feel effects. Sensitive groups should avoid outdoor exertion; others should limit it.
guide-haz: Health warning of emergency conditions: everyone should avoid outdoor exertion.
what-is-aqi-body: The Air Quality Index (AQI) turns a pollution concentration into a 0–500 scale and a named category. Higher is worse: 0–50 is Good, 100+ starts to affect sensitive people.
aqi-usg: Unhealthy for sensitive groups — AQI 101 to 150
aqi-window: The AQI shown is computed from each block's hourly mean, not a 24-hour average.
provisional: Provisional blocks have only early, uncalibrated readings — still being double-checked, and never shown as a confirmed category. Status is conveyed by text and pattern, not color alone.
how-to-read: How to read this — and what it does not say
trust-summary: Confirmed readings are calibrated against a reference monitor and carry a ± uncertainty. Provisional readings are early and uncalibrated. This page reports what the air and heat readings are; it does not tell anyone they are safe. Use it alongside how you feel and official advisories.
footer-data: Observations are public domain (CC0-1.0). Download the full history — no account, no key.
footer-note: Each reading carries its calibration state and, when calibrated, a published uncertainty.
no-data: No data yet. Run `swelter demo --serve` or `make demo`.
